title: Prioritising Mental Health Care and Support for Singaporeans
what_it_is: Prioritising Mental Health Care and Support for Singaporeans

sections.label: Progressive mental health legislation approach
sections.summary: The speaker says their approach is that progressive legislation promotes mental healthcare access and rights, and welcomes the COVID-19 Mental Wellness Task Force's August 2021 recommendations for a whole-of-Government strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: We have been consistent in our approach that progressive legislation can effectively promote access to mental healthcare and protect the rights of persons with mental health issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Therefore, I welcome recommendations put forth by the COVID-19 Mental Wellness Task force in August 2021 to provide a whole-of- Government strategy to address the psychosocial impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

sections.label: Suicide rate all-time high
sections.summary: The suicide rate reached an all-time high of 452, a 13% increase from 2019, with increases across all age groups.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Our suicide rate reached its all time high of 452, a 13% increase from 2019, with an increase across all age groups.

sections.label: Whole of Society Approach mindset
sections.summary: The speaker urges everyone, as part of the Whole of Society Approach, to change their mindset on how they view children's development, from daily school issues to major examinations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: On that note, I urge everyone as part of our “Whole of Society Approach” to change our mindset on how we view children's development, from daily school issues to major examinations.

sections.label: Medisave limit for mental health
sections.summary: The annual Medisave limit is $700 a year from 2022, and the Government could explore increasing the Medisave claim limit for mental health consultations, which can be more regular for those needing help.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: For example, the annual Medisave limit is $700 a year from the year 2022.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Perhaps the Government could explore increasing the Medisave claim limit for mental health consultations given that such consultations can be a bit more more regular for those who need more help.

sections.label: 452 suicide cases recorded
sections.summary: Last year the country recorded 452 suicide cases, which the speaker calls very worrying.

sentences.speaker: Dr Wan Rizal (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: Last year, our country recorded 452 suicide cases, and this is very worrying.

sections.label: Funding for community mental health services
sections.summary: In 2017, a further $160 million was committed to enhance and expand community mental health services over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: In 2017, we have committed a further $160 million to enhance and expand community mental health services over the next five years.

sections.label: Polyclinics and GP mental health
sections.summary: By end 2020, 14 polyclinics offered mental health or dementia services and over 220 GP partners were trained to diagnose and treat mental health conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: As at end 2020, 14 polyclinics offer mental health and/ or dementia services and, over 220 General Practitioner (GP) partners are trained to diagnose and treat mental health conditions.

sections.label: MediSave CDMP mental health limit
sections.summary: About three in 10 patients using MediSave for CDMP mental health conditions reached the yearly $500 withdrawal limit.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: Based on the latest available data, about three in 10 patients who utilised MediSave for the treatment of CDMP mental health conditions reached the yearly $500 MediSave withdrawal limit.

sections.label: COVID-19 and mental health initiatives
sections.summary: The Government expanded or newly introduced over 40 mental health-related initiatives last year, anticipating increased mental health needs from the COVID-19 pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: The Government is aware that the COVID-19 pandemic has brought about unprecedented shifts in the way we live and work, and resulted in stressors that impact our mental well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: It is in anticipation of the increase in mental health needs in our population that the Government and various agencies have expanded or newly introduced over 40 mental health-related initiatives last year.

sections.label: Inter-agency mental health task force
sections.summary: MOH and MSF set up a new Inter-agency task force on Mental Health and Well-being to oversee efforts and develop a National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: To better prepare for the future, MOH and MSF have also set up the new Inter-agency task force on Mental Health and Well-being, which will oversee mental health and well-being efforts, focusing on cross-cutting issues that require inter-agency collaborations.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: The new task force will form workgroups to review cross-cutting gaps and issues for example specific measures targeted at those that are more vulnerable or at risk, to identify potential solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam)
sentences.text: We will develop an overarching National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy.
